criteria.name: 1 simultaneous reservations from several processes never exceed the cap
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 2 the window slides with each message instead of resetting at a fixed time
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 3 the minimum gap between messages is enforced and ends on time
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 4 a refused attempt is not counted and does not restart the gap or window
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 5 history survives restarts and is shared: a new process sees earlier sends, other state dirs are separate
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 6 release from another process gives the slot back, once
criteria.label: outcome
